responsibility: Defines the CRIS-specific command-line options and the target variables or masks they control. It is the option table for architecture/version selection, tuning and alignment modes, prologue/epilogue suppression, multiply-bug workaround handling, stackframe warnings, trap strategy for abort and unaligned atomics, library-vs-trap atomic handling, and related compatibility aliases, providing the declarative option metadata that the driver and backend use to parse and configure CRIS code generation.
same_name_distinction: Unlike cris.cc, cris.h, and cris.md, this file is the declarative option table for the CRIS port: it enumerates -m switches, masks, variables, defaults, and help text used to parse/configure the target, rather than implementing backend behavior, defining target macros, or describing RTL instruction patterns.
